mods.name: Better Chest Storage
mods.description: Fuse a block of chests into one shared inventory with a wooden Chest Connector. No pipes, no controllers, no machinery to hide.

releases.notes:
## What's new

The Chest Connector can now be crafted. Until now the tool existed only in the creative inventory, which left the mod effectively unusable in survival.

### Crafting

```
.  P  P
P  S  P
S  P  .
```

`P` is any planks — oak, spruce, birch, bamboo, anything in the `#minecraft:planks` tag — and `S` is a stick. The recipe shows up in the recipe book as soon as you pick up planks.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.3
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- Fabric API

## Installation

Download `better-chest-storage-1.1.0.jar` and drop it into your `mods` folder.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/Rodrigo-AO/better_chest_storage/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0

mods.name: Better Chest Storage
mods.description: Fuse a block of chests into one shared inventory with a wooden Chest Connector. No pipes, no controllers, no machinery to hide.

releases.notes:
First release of **Better Chest Storage** — merge a solid block of chests into one shared inventory using just a hand tool. No pipes, no controller block, no memory bank, and no complex engineering system that ends up eating space at your home.

## Requirements

- Minecraft **26.3**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.5**+
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- Java 25

## Installation

Drop `better-chest-storage-1.0.0.jar` into your `mods` folder alongside Fabric API.

## The Chest Connector

A wooden wrench, found in the *Tools and Utilities* creative tab.

| Gesture | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Sneak + hold right click**, drag, release | Selects the dragged area of chests |
| **Ctrl + right click** inside a selection | Connects it into one shared storage |
| **Ctrl + left click** on a selection | Cancels the selection |
| **Ctrl + left click** on a connected area | Disconnects it |
| Just holding the tool | Shows every connected area around you |

Selections are outlined in oak, connected networks in the darker brown of a chest texture.

## Shared storage

Opening **any** chest of a network shows the same aggregated screen: one cell per item kind with the total the whole network holds, plus a search field and a scrollbar.

The network owns no storage of its own — every block extracted or dropped in it goes straight through to the vanilla chest block entities inside the area. Two players browsing the same item on the network from two different chests see the exact same amount, so duplication souldn't be possible.

If you want to break the selection, the chests will fill up from the top one downwards. Disconnect a network and you already know where its contents ended up.

## Rules

- Every block in the area must be a chest — no gaps, not even air.
- An area can't cut a double chest in half.
- Maximum 256 chests per network.

Hoppers, comparators and everything else keep working against the individual chests as usual.

> **Note:** this first release compiles and loads cleanly, but in-world behaviour has had limited playtesting. Bug reports welcome.
